evals.name: bootstrap-minimal
evals.prompt:
Add a runtime friction-feedback inbox to the target skill using meta-skill-feedback.

Target (copy — do not edit the fixture under evals/): work inside your outputs directory.

1. Copy `evals/fixtures/minimal-skill/` to `outputs/minimal-skill/`.
2. Bootstrap feedback on `outputs/minimal-skill/` per meta-skill-feedback (feedback/, README, cues in SKILL.md).
3. Write `outputs/metrics.json` with `{ "eval": "bootstrap-minimal", "target": "outputs/minimal-skill" }`.
4. Write `transcript.md` summarizing steps.

Do not seed example friction notes unless you hit real friction during this task.
evals.expected_output: outputs/minimal-skill/ has feedback/README.md, feedback/resolved/, and SKILL.md cues agents to write friction files. No scaffold script added.
expectations: No new friction note files in outputs/minimal-skill/feedback/ except README.md
No scripts/scaffold.py was created under outputs/minimal-skill/

evals.name: bootstrap-wake-shaped
evals.prompt:
Add a runtime friction-feedback inbox to the wake-shaped fixture using meta-skill-feedback.

1. Copy `evals/fixtures/wake-shaped-skill/` to `outputs/wake-shaped-skill/`.
2. Bootstrap feedback; this skill has references/wake.md — add an appropriate finish-line cue there or in SKILL.md (at most two touchpoints total).
3. Adapt feedback/README.md for scheduled-wake context.
4. Write metrics.json and transcript.md as in bootstrap-minimal.
evals.expected_output: Wake-shaped skill bootstrapped with feedback inbox and wake-appropriate cues.
expectations: references/wake.md or SKILL.md mentions feedback/ for agents finishing a wake run
feedback/README.md mentions wake or scheduled/unattended context
No friction note files seeded except README.md

evals.name: runtime-quiet
evals.prompt:
Simulate a **routine quiet run** of an already-bootstrapped skill.

The fixture `evals/fixtures/wake-shaped-bootstrapped/` already has feedback/ set up.

1. Copy it to `outputs/wake-shaped-bootstrapped/` (do not modify evals/fixtures).
2. Read feedback/README.md. You had a routine successful run with no surprises.
3. Follow the runtime rules: **do not** write a friction file; **do not** edit SKILL.md or wake.md.
4. Write metrics.json and transcript.md explaining why no friction file was added.
evals.expected_output: Copy unchanged except metrics/transcript; no new feedback/*.md files.
expectations: outputs/wake-shaped-bootstrapped/SKILL.md was not modified from the fixture copy
Only feedback/README.md exists under feedback/ (no extra .md notes)
